notes.title: 2025/03/19　Update information
notes.content:
The English version can now be selected from the options menu.

How to Switch to the English Version

Open the menu.
Go to "Options."
Press the Shift key or the RB button on your controller to access the second page.
Select "English" under "Language."

Important: Please make sure to save from the "Save Menu." m( )m
